data.title: Repo Borrowing Costs Rise as Treasury Yields Surge
data.description:
The cost to borrow key short-term Treasuries is rising as investors buy recently issued securities to establish short positions, according to Bloomberg.

The move could support next week’s US government debt auctions.

data.title: BMO Upgrades MACOM Technology Solutions to Outperform, Sees 27% Upside
data.description: According to CNBC, BMO Capital Markets upgraded MACOM Technology Solutions to outperform from market perform and kept its price target at $335 per share, implying 27% upside from Thursday's close. Analyst Harsh Kumar said valuations have become attractive as forward multiples fell from the high-50s in June to 29x, and said fundamentals have stayed solid on demand from datacenter and industrial/defense markets, with defense resilient and space becoming a material growth contributor next year. The bank said MACOM's data center business could benefit as hyperscalers, cloud service providers and AI labs direct more spending toward AI compute and networking infrastructure. It also said revenue from the data center vertical is expected to grow 70% in fiscal 2026, after a 47% increase in the prior fiscal year. Shares of MACOM have fallen about 30% over the past three months and trade more than 30% below their late-May peak of $418.90. LSEG data show 13 of 18 analysts covering MACOM rate the stock buy or strong buy, while five rate it hold.

data.title: Yahoo Finance Ends Prediction Market Partnership With Polymarket
data.description:
Yahoo Finance has ended its prediction market partnership with Polymarket, which was reached in November last year. According to Foresight News, Polymarket data had been displayed exclusively on Yahoo Finance for probabilities tied to economic, government, and market forecasts, but the section was taken offline in April this year.

Yahoo said Polymarket remains an advertising partner and that similar cooperation is still possible. Polymarket declined to comment.

data.title: Chip Roy Says Congress Should Hear From AI CEOs on Safety Concerns
data.description: According to CNBC, U.S. Representative Chip Roy said Congress has an oversight role in artificial intelligence but does not need to regulate the technology. Speaking on "Squawk Box," the Texas Republican said he does not want to regulate anything and instead favors AI chief executives testifying at congressional hearings to explain what they are doing to address safety concerns. Roy said Congress has a role in asking companies what they are doing about a technology that is so pervasive, and he added that he is not an AI "doomer."

data.title: STOCKS | Macron Plans G7 Meeting on Possible Strategic Oil Reserve Release
data.description:
French President Emmanuel Macron said he will convene a Group of Seven meeting in the coming weeks to discuss the possible release of strategic oil reserves. According to Sina Finance, Macron said at a press conference in Paris on Friday that he will call the G7 meeting to strengthen coordination among countries on reserve levels and expand cooperation on exports and production capacity.

Macron said the meeting will focus on strengthening cooperation and avoiding unnecessary tensions between G7 countries and their major partners, while examining options for a possible release of strategic reserves.

data.title: South Africa Delays AI Rules Pending Global Standards Review
data.description:
South Africa’s financial regulator will wait for findings from a study by the world’s top standards-setting body before creating new artificial intelligence rules for the country, according to Bloomberg.

The regulator said it will hold off on setting up the new framework until the review is complete.

data.description: A trader address starting with 0xaeaa bought into Bitcoin's move above $80,000 and opened a long position on 450 BTC, according to Lookonchain monitoring. According to Foresight News, the position is currently showing an unrealized profit of $276,000.

data.title: AI TRENDS | XPeng Chairman He Xiaopeng Says G9L Is a Global Car With High Expectations
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, XPeng Group Chairman and CEO He Xiaopeng said in a media interview that G9L is another "global car" under XPeng, and the company has high expectations for the new model in sales, profit, and incremental overseas market growth.

data.title: AI TRENDS | Polymarket Completes Website Performance Upgrade, Boosts Market Loading Speeds
data.description:
Polymarket has completed a website performance upgrade, according to a post by Engineering Vice President Josh Stevens. According to Foresight News, the company built a new internal gateway API with Rust and restructured related pages.

The update increased combined market loading speed by eight times and sports market loading speed by four times, and it is now live. Polymarket said it will continue optimizing the events, esports, categories, and homepage pages.

data.title: ETH Faces $964 Million Long Liquidation Risk Below $2,434
data.description: ETH could trigger $964 million in cumulative long liquidations on major centralized exchanges if it falls below $2,434. According to ChainCatcher, if ETH rises above $2,688, cumulative short liquidation intensity on major centralized exchanges would reach $262 million.

data.title: DeBot Confirms APT Attack in Wallet Security Incident, No Funds Lost
data.description:
DeBot team member Cat said the earlier wallet security incident was an APT attack and that no related funds losses have been found. According to Odaily, multiple security teams and cloud service providers found signs of intrusion, and the platform will continue automatic fund isolation because related private keys remain at risk.

DeBot said it is now operating in a fully isolated environment. Users can still trade and withdraw funds, while other private-key-related functions remain suspended until the security audit is completed and services are gradually restored.

The company said a new security plan is being upgraded and is under audit by SlowMist and cloud service providers. DeBot added that the incident exposed security issues in the project and that the team will further strengthen its security measures.

data.title: SBI Digital Practice and Kyobo Life Complete Cross-Border Token Pilot on Canton Network
data.description:
SBI Digital Practice, a Canton business subsidiary of SBI Holdings, and South Korean life insurer Kyobo Life completed a cross-border pilot in a Canton Network test environment, directly exchanging a yen-pegged test token for a won-pegged test token.

According to Odaily, the pilot covered cross-border transfer, exchange, settlement, receipt, and custody of digital tokens, with funds moving from Japan to South Korea without converting into U.S. dollars. Kyobo Life said it was the first verification in South Korea's insurance industry of the full process for institutional cross-border transfer, exchange, and settlement.

The two sides plan further cooperation on digital asset exchange, overseas investment, asset management, and tokenized asset transfers. Kyobo Life also tested procedures for receiving, storing, and managing digital assets and related settlement funds in South Korea.

data.title: Banks Increase Share of EU MiCA Crypto Providers to Nearly 23%
data.description:
Banks increased their share of EU MiCA crypto providers to nearly 23%. According to NS3.AI, the number of banks on the register doubled to about 80 between June 26 and Sept. 16.

The overall number of listed providers also rose during the same period, climbing from 243 to 349.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | LNG Tanker Carrying US Fuel to Europe Hit by Suspected Cyberattack
data.description:
A liquefied natural gas tanker carrying fuel from the US to Europe suffered a systems failure that the crew reported as a suspected cyberattack, according to people familiar with the matter.

Bloomberg reported the incident involved a tanker with a US cargo bound for Europe.

data.title: Zcash Coinholders Back Scheduled Halvings and Future Block Reward Changes
data.description:
Zcash coinholders favored keeping the scheduled halvings, with 2,375,932.375 ZEC supporting that option. According to NS3.AI, a separate vote also favored beginning to return ZEC collected by the Network Sustainability Mechanism to future block rewards in February 2031.

The advisory poll does not activate any changes, schedule NU7, or guarantee that every preferred feature will be implemented.

data.title: AI | Makers of ‘The Blood of Dawnwalker’ Detail $40 Million Development
data.description:
The makers of the hit game discussed the relatively smooth development of The Blood of Dawnwalker, according to Bloomberg.

The project carried a $40 million budget.
